changelog: Import folder (Admin\ImportFolder, Import\FolderQueue), off by default: CSV files a warehouse or label tool drops into a folder are imported every hour with the CSV import's checks, then moved to done/ (with a report of skipped rows) or failed/. The folder is in uploads under a random name, closed to the web; CTRACKING_IMPORT_DIR or the ctracking_import_path filter move it. Settings: Mark shipped, Dates with slashes. Nothing is fetched.
Spanish (es_ES) and German (de_DE), machine-translated; to be reviewed by native speakers.

The tracking page showing an order defines DONOTCACHEPAGE (through wc_nocache_headers()), so WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket and LiteSpeed Cache leave it out; headers alone didn't stop WP Super Cache. The form page stays cacheable.
The tracking page's steps and history are no longer indented by a theme's content list padding (Kadence's .single-content ol).
The Tracking page and Returns and help page settings are named by their labels for screen readers (plain selects in place of WooCommerce's single_select_page).
The shipping report keeps each range's figures for an hour, cleared when tracking, a parcel's status or an order's status changes, instead of reading up to 2,001 orders on every view.
templates/tracking-page.php (version 1.6.0) prints aria-current and is-problem through esc_attr(); the current step is aria-current="step", the others "false".
Translator comments sit directly above each carrier label string; the update manifest reads a package address's host and path without parse_url().
French for France: "l’e-mail" and "cet e-mail" in place of "le e-mail" and "ce e-mail".

Activation (Plugin::activate()) starts the import folder as well as the status poll; deactivation and uninstall stop ctracking_import_folder; uninstall deletes the import folder's options and the report's cache (not the folder's files).
